defs.def: ot long ago 不久前；最近

ex.s: Shabnam Azimi and Alexander Krasnikov of Loyola University of Chicago and Kwong Chan of Northeastern University recently published a study on fake reviews.
ex.t: 芝加哥洛约拉大学的Shabnam Azimi、Alexander Krasnikov和东北大学的Kwong Chan最近发表了一项关于虚假评论的研究。

ex.s: You may not know the term, but that feeling is “kama muta”, a recently ____16____ (name) emotion that marks some of the most important moments in our life.
ex.t: 你可能不知道这个术语，但这种感觉就是“kama muta”（触动），一种最近被____16____（命名）的情感，标志着我们生命中一些最重要的时刻。

ex.s: Until recently, scientific evidence had been limited to one aspect of morality: kindness.
ex.t: 直到最近，科学证据还仅限于道德的一个方面：善良。

ex.s: However, obtaining items that are rare, recently published or in high demand may take longer.
ex.t: 然而，获取稀有、新出版或需求量大的物品可能需要更长时间。

ex.s: Heatherwick Studio recently built a greenhouse at the edge of the National Trust’s Woolbeding Gardens.
ex.t: Heatherwick工作室最近在英国国家信托Woolbeding花园的边缘建了一座温室。

ex.s: What has Trost been doing recently?
ex.t: 特罗斯特最近在做什么？

ex.s: More recently, as books have become inexpensive or even throwaway, artists have used them as the raw material for artworks — transforming covers, pages or even complete volumes into paintings and sculptures.
ex.t: 更近一些时候，随着书籍变得廉价甚至可以随意丢弃，艺术家们开始把它们用作艺术品的原材料——把封面、书页甚至整册书变成绘画和雕塑。

ex.s: It is recently reported that the number of those sticking to a traditional diet is slowly declining and around half of Britain’s consumers would like to change or improve their cooking in some way.
ex.t: 最近有报道称，坚持传统饮食的人数正在缓慢下降，约一半英国消费者想以某种方式改变或改善自己的烹饪。

ex.s: Recently, scientists have started a debate on _______the computers will “think” like human in half a century.
ex.t: 最近，科学家们就____计算机在半个世纪后是否会像人类一样“思考”展开了辩论。

ex.s: Nina recently finished her year-long series of runs in Chicago, ____18____ thousands were attending a water conference.She called for action ____19____(address)the struggles of people around the world ____20____(face) “too little water or too dirty water”.
ex.t: 妮娜最近在芝加哥完成了她长达一年的系列跑步，（第18空）数千人正参加一场水会议。她呼吁采取行动（第19空，address）世界各地人们（第20空，face）"水太少或水太脏"的困境。

ex.s: Efforts to improve teaching at the university level have recently emerged.
ex.t: 大学层面改进教学的努力最近才出现。

ex.s: The Chinese government recently finalized a plan to set up a Giant Panda National Park(GPNP). ___56___ (cover)an area about three times ___57___ size of Yellowstone National Park, the GPNP will be one of the first national parks in the country.
ex.t: 中国政府最近敲定了一项建立大熊猫国家公园（GPNP）的计划。（第56空，cover）约（第57空）黄石国家公园三倍的面积，GPNP将成为该国首批国家公园之一。

ex.s: Recently a leading scientist said the scientific method was to avoid fooling oneself into thinking something is true that is not.
ex.t: 最近，一位顶尖科学家说，科学方法就是避免自欺欺人地相信不真实的东西。

ex.s: The French take their 35-hour workweek seriously — so seriously that some labor unions recently struck a deal with a group of companies limiting the number of hours that independent contractors can be on call.
ex.t: 法国人极其看重35小时工作周——以至于一些工会最近与一批公司达成协议，限制独立承包商待命的时长。

ex.s: I've traveled back several times since, most recently this past spring.
ex.t: 从那以后我又回去过几次，最近一次是在今年春天。

ex.s: But I recently came across a study that shows why his approach works
ex.t: 但我最近偶然看到一项研究，说明了他的方法为何有效

ex.s: Recently，I took a trip home by train．I got a seat opposite a middle-aged man with sharp eyes，who kept____1____a young woman in a window seat with a little boy on her lap．The woman's eye fell on the man's face，and she immediately looked down and____2____her scarf．
ex.t: 最近，我乘火车回家。我坐在一位目光锐利的中年男子对面，他一直___1___一位坐在靠窗座位、腿上抱着小男孩的年轻女子。女子的目光落在男子脸上，立刻低下头___2___自己的围巾。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

ex.s: He has recently made a significant   16 —loneliness is a serious social problem that can contribute to depression and even crimes, but it can be   17   in a clever way.
ex.t: 他最近有了一个重要的___16___——孤独是一个严重的社会问题，可能导致抑郁甚至犯罪，但它可以用巧妙的方式被___17___。

ex.s: Zac recently returned another lost medal to a family in Alabama.
ex.t: 扎克最近把另一枚丢失的勋章归还给阿拉巴马州的一个家庭。

ex.s: Researchers in Spain and England recently found that the worms of the greater wax moth can break down polyethylene, which accounts for 40% of plastics.
ex.t: 西班牙和英格兰的研究者最近发现，大蜡螟的幼虫能分解占塑料40%的聚乙烯。

ex.s: Some of the world’s most famous musicians recently gathered in Paris and New Orleans to celebrate the first annual International Jazz Day.
ex.t: 世界上一些最著名的音乐家最近齐聚巴黎和新奥尔良，庆祝首个年度国际爵士日。

ex.s: Recently, we bought a twenty-eight-foot travel trailer complete with a bathroom and a built-in TV set.
ex.t: 最近，我们买了一辆二十八英尺长的旅居拖车，配有浴室和内置电视机。

ex.s: But recently it has discovered that data can be turned into new services: translation and visual recognition, to be sold to other companies.
ex.t: 但最近它发现数据可以被转化为新服务：翻译和视觉识别，然后出售给其他公司。

ex.s: More recently, the foundation began another  47  called National Red Scarf Day --- a day when people donate $20 and wear red scarves in support of Canada’s  48   and homeless.
ex.t: 最近，该基金会又发起了一项名为“全国红围巾日”的活动——这一天人们捐出20美元并戴上红围巾，以支持加拿大的____和无家可归者。

ex.s: I know she's been busy recently, and I understand that.
ex.t: 我知道她最近很忙，我也理解。

ex.s: However, until recently no one knew how they did this.
ex.t: 然而，直到最近没有人知道他们是怎么做到的。

ex.s: But recently, some “green truths” have been shown to be only half true, or even completely false.
ex.t: 但最近，一些“绿色真相”被证明只有一半是真的，甚至完全是假的。

ex.s: Recently, I asked a friend who had just returned from a long walk in the woods what she had observed.
ex.t: 最近，我问了一位刚从林中长途散步回来的朋友，她都观察到了什么。

ex.s: Dining in the Dark Recently I dined at a "dark restaurant", where people eat in complete darkness, served by blind staff.
ex.t: 暗夜用餐　最近我在一家“黑暗餐厅”用餐，那里人们在完全黑暗中进餐，由失明的员工服务。
